data.name: Verano
data.detailed_description:
Early Playtest

We are currently in very early stages of development. Although most systems have been prototyped, we're re-building them with best practices in mind, and while integrating new functionality introduced during the prototype process.

Currently there is no focus on in-game art (strictly placeholder at the moment), except outside the game there is quite a bit of a glow-up waiting to be introduced at the right time. Characters, story, creatures-- they are all constantly being worked on and waiting for when the water is right.

Stay tuned!


 


About the Game

On the surface, Verano offers a gentle blend of exploration and fishing. Players sail between islands, discover vibrant fishing spots filled with unique sea life, and engage in dynamic, skill-based fishing encounters through quests and challenges.

Gameplay

  • Exploration

    Sail the open seas to uncover new fishing grounds and encounter a wide array of marine species.

  • Fishing

    Players are challenged to anticipate fish behavior and use a mix of reflexes, timing, and stamina to reel in their catch. Advanced encounters demand mastery of mechanics and keen observation.

  • Upgrade

    Catches can be sold to earn new gear, bait, and tools that unlock access to new areas and rarer species. Tools can be strategically combined to better suit specific challenges, making progress feel both personal and purposeful.

While Verano is designed to be accessible and instantly engaging, aimed at both casual and extended play, it's narrative subtly unfolds over the curse of one unexpected summer. As the summer festival nears the island, fish are becoming scarce and an ominous and large serpentine-like creature lurks the island's shores in darkness.

data.short_description: Verano is a third-person fishing adventure set in a fantastical archipelago. Players step into the role of a young fisherman who embarks on a heartfelt quest to find a cure for a mysterious curse.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 5600XT (6GB VRAM) / Intel Arc A750 (8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 Super (8GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (12GB VRAM) / Intel Arc B580 (12GB VRAM)
